values: A human observer (foaf:Person) is the sosa:Sensor; the procedure forest_mensuration is a sosa:Procedure. Experimental plots are seen as sosa:Sample.
Multimedia results (sosa:Result subclass) decomposed into temporal and spatial segments carrying MPEG-7-style descriptors, aligned with the Media Resource ontology.
Observation classes per property kind, restricted with owl:allValuesFrom on sosa:observedProperty; static property values attached directly to the property (osph:hasPropertySimpleValue).

Observation types are subclasses of sosa:Observation with OWL restrictions on result, observed property and usedProcedure; laboratory procedures are both sosa:Procedure and skos:Concept; alignments with ISO 19156.
An animal (southern elephant seal) is the sosa:Platform; location is itself observed, with a WKT geometry as the result.

Static design properties carry value and unit directly (brick:value, brick:hasUnit) instead of observations; sensors point to external time series by ID (Brick ref:hasTimeseriesID). SHACL shapes validate sosa:Actuator descriptions.

Each VSS signal becomes a property class with matching sensor/actuator classes; vehicle branches are features of interest. Contextual driving facts (traffic flow, visibility) are modelled as observations.
Proposes to treat sosa:Observation, sosa:Actuation and sosa:Sampling as subclasses of dcat:Dataset to attach DUV user feedback for a GEO label.
Uses the 2009 SSN (observationResultTime, SensorOutput) with DUL; property values are also stored on entity properties (hasValue) with the observation time.
Observations carry a trust score (ts) and a description target; JSON-LD messages per spatial entity.
Micro-controllers are subclasses of ssn:System implementing sosa:Procedures (algorithms); WoT TD aligned with td:Thing subclass of ssn:System and td:InteractionPattern subclass of sosa:Procedure.
Observations are also typed void:Dataset; collections are aggregated recursively along spatial, temporal and property dimensions.
ssn:observes links a service or its telemetry to a seas:Process rather than a sensor to a property.
Rules over observations infer domain facts (an area with high CO becomes :OffLimitArea); SHACL schemas over SOSA triple patterns.

SSN/SOSA classes re-classified under BFO/CCO (sosa:FeatureOfInterest under an information content entity, ObservableProperty under bfo:quality); sensor kinds defined as subclasses (temperature sensor, pressure sensor).

Uses non-existent SOSA terms (sosa:madeObservation, sosa:hasObservableProperty, sosa:isObservedBy) and ssn:Device as a subclass of ssn:System; a controller regulates observable properties (priv:controls).
Automatic ontology alignment maps aras:Sensor to sosa:Sensor.
One observation node per sensor acts as a template (no result value, no time) holding the real-time data key and topic; time series stay outside the graph.
Data-quality tags attached to observations (hasObservationTag) and a CorrectedValue subclass of ssn:ObservationValue linked by hasCorrectedValue; SWRL rules classify suspect data.
An extra PO2:hasObjectOfInterest names the object observed within the feature; sensors and actuators may be human agents (a tasting panel).

Dataset-level metadata model: dcat:Dataset linked to sosa:ObservationCollection, with FeatureTheme and PropertyTheme SKOS concepts as thematic abstractions beside FeatureOfInterest and ObservableProperty.
The result of a web service call (a Yelp search) is wrapped as a sosa observation blank node by a JavaScript accessor.
Reuses sosa:madeObservation and sosa:observes in a manufacturing ontology; machines 'host' tools in the prose.
Observation classes defined in DL (HighTrafficObservation, ∃observedProperty.CongestionLevel) and inferred by cascading stream reasoning.
Invents ssn:-prefixed data properties for weather variables (ssn:Temperature, ssn:WindSpeed, ssn:relativehumidity) and object properties (ssn:area).
Design choices from an alignment exercise: ssn:Property used in place of sosa:ObservableProperty, sosa:isHostedBy linking a sensor to the room it is installed in.

Alternative observation designs: mssn:AltObservationDesign subclass of ssn:Observation, with refined altFeatureOfInterest, altObservedProperty and altObservedBy to flag multiple mappings of one dataset.
Observation subclasses defined by OWL class expressions (NursePresentObservation, SoundAboveThresholdFault) so that reasoning classifies observations into faults and nurse calls.
SHACL SPARQL rules built from automatic alignments rewrite oneM2M and OCF data into SOSA observations.
Sensor-centred triples (sensor hasUnit, hasQuantityKind, hasResult) in the work's MIoT-Ont namespace, without observation individuals.
Rules as SPARQL CONSTRUCT stored in RDF (SPIN-like rso:) classify observations (health:Healthy); misspelled ssn:observerBy.
SOSA terms re-declared as a PROV extension (prov-sw:) so that observations are prov:Activity associated with the sensor and generating the result.
SWRL rules over observation results flag abnormal vital signs; a vital sign is linked to its observations by an own VitalSignhasObservation property.
sosa:hasSimpleResult used with a structured QUDT node instead of a literal.
Attributes of geographic entities in a narrative map are modelled as observations grouped per entity in a collection whose feature is the map content item.
The ontology evolves from the sensor data stream, under a consistency model for updates and new concepts.
Calibration models (OM plus Content MathML) attached to sensors through a new calibratedSensor class; measures with metrological uncertainty.
RDF-star annotates a sensor's hasSimpleResult statement with a certainty value (ex:probability), aggregated by weighted average.
sosa:resultTime drives window membership of LDP stream containers.
Observations are evidence (EvidenceObservation) clustered into maintained hazard events; one feature of interest per incoming bundle.
A whole observing campaign (EHT VLBI) is one sosa:Observation linked to an observatory and to observational data.
GEO label facets are computed from SOSA/SSN graphs, e.g. user feedback attached to a sosa:Observation with duv:hasUserFeedback.
Observations are indexed into a time-series store by declared predicate patterns (value, time, sensor, reading type).
Sensor kinds of the pilot (fibre-optic, acceleration) defined as subclasses of sosa:Sensor.
Discusses aligning SAREF with SOSA, e.g. saref:BuildingSpace as a subclass of sosa:Platform.
An own property (p:sourceStation) links an observation to the weather station it comes from instead of madeBySensor.
Satellite subsystems are subclasses of sosa:Platform, generated automatically from channel lists.
Feature-of-interest subclasses are used to derive a category tree of marketplace offerings.
An own ca:MeasurementCode (e.g. ca:TMAX-d combining quantity, aggregation and sampling interval) plays the role of sosa:ObservableProperty, without using SOSA.
Laptop hardware components (temperature, pressure, humidity sensors) reuse sosa:Sensor subclasses in a digital product passport ontology.
A capability ontology (C4I) is aligned with SSN through a separate bridging module (C4I2SSN).
